snippet.title: Armor Attack - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Unleash your battle machines. Subscribe to join pre-alpha tests: https://armor-attack.com

Control monstrous battle machines as a part of an elite squad that outplays opponents using superior planning and execution. Combine tactical maps, unique abilities, and exotic weapon builds to trap, ambush, and encircle your enemies or to make your last stand an unforgettable combat experience.

Follow our accounts in socials: 
- Facebook: /playarmorattack
- X: /armorattack
